text.tspan: Terraform compares three things: your code, the state file, and real AWS
terraform plan = refresh state from AWS, then diff code vs state
→ + create ~ update in place -/+ replace - destroy
never edit by hand; use terraform state mv / rm
never commit it to Git (secrets inside)
one state per env/component (small blast radius)
